name: csv_summarizer
description: A powerful CSV file summarizer that provides statistical analysis, data insights, and visualization recommendations

tools.name: summarize_csv
tools.description: Read a CSV file and generate a comprehensive statistical summary including basic info, data types, missing values, and visualization recommendations

file_path.description: Path to the CSV file to analyze

output_format.description: Format of the output summary (json or text)

save_to_file.description: Optional path to save the summary to a file

tools.name: get_csv_info
tools.description: Get basic information about a CSV file including row count, column names, and data types

tools.name: recommend_visualizations
tools.description: Analyze CSV data and recommend appropriate visualizations based on data characteristics

file_path.description: Path to the CSV file to analyze
